from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

def task_func(df, target_column):
    if df.empty:
        raise ValueError("Input dataframe must not be empty.")
    if target_column not in df.columns:
        raise KeyError(f"Target column '{target_column}' not found in dataframe.")

    data = df.dropna(subset=[target_column]).copy()
    if data.empty:
        raise ValueError("No rows available after removing missing target values.")

    X = data.drop(columns=[target_column]).copy()
    y = data[target_column]

    if X.shape[1] == 0:
        raise ValueError("Input dataframe must contain at least one feature column.")

    numeric_cols = set(X.select_dtypes(include=["number"]).columns)

    for col in X.columns:
        if col in numeric_cols:
            if X[col].isna().any():
                median_value = X[col].median()
                if median_value != median_value:  # NaN check without importing pandas
                    median_value = 0
                X[col] = X[col].fillna(median_value)
        else:
            X[col] = X[col].astype("category").cat.codes

    clf = RandomForestClassifier(random_state=42)
    clf.fit(X, y)

    importances = clf.feature_importances_
    sorted_idx = importances.argsort()[::-1]
    sorted_features = X.columns[sorted_idx]
    sorted_importances = importances[sorted_idx]

    fig_height = max(4, 0.4 * len(sorted_features))
    _, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(10, fig_height))
    sns.barplot(x=list(sorted_importances), y=list(sorted_features), ax=ax, orient="h")

    ax.set_xlabel("Feature Importance Score")
    ax.set_ylabel("Features")
    ax.set_title("Visualizing Important Features")
    plt.tight_layout()

    return clf, ax
